The '''Battle of Turcan III''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought on [[Turcan III]]. Despite being an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] victory, the battle brought [[Churhee's Riflemen]] galaxywide fame as heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].

==Prelude==
During their early [[Standard year/Legends|years]], [[Churhee's Riflemen]] regularly accepted missions from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel]] and [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="GAW" />

That changed after a [[Mission on Y'Trella|mission]] on [[Y'Trella]], where the group found itself pinned down by the enemy and abandoned by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] that had promised to provide backup. Almost all the Riflemen perished, and their founder, [[Vlaydm Churhee]], was among the [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="GAW" />

After the debacle on Y'Trella, the survivors regrouped on [[Turcan III]] under the leadership of Vlaydm's widow, [[Maydla Churhee]].<ref name="GAW" /> In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] that followed, Maydla Churhee rebuilt the unit, this time as a fiercely anti-Imperial organization. Thereafter, Churhee's Riflemen took anti-Imperial contracts only, and allied themselves with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="AJ15" /> Because of the high quality of [[Sniper/Legends|marksmanship]] among their members, the Riflemen became a real thorn in the side of the Empire, particularly in the Parmel sector.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

==The battle==
During several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], Churhee's Riflemen helped local [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance ground forces]] on Turcan III to fight the Empire. The Riflemen became such an irritant to the Empire that Parmel sector's [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tallis]] eventually dedicated a whole [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Naval]] [[line]] to support the Imperial [[Battle group/Legends|battlegroup]] already present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AJ15" />

With these additional resources, the Empire launched a full-scale military assault on Turcan III. More than half of the Riflemen died while fighting a rear-guard delaying action, which gave the Rebels enough time to evacuate the planet.<ref name="GAW" /> Contrarily to what had happened on Y'Trella, the surviving Riflemen were evacuated by the Alliance, in the last [[Transport/Legends|transport]] going offworld.<ref name="AJ15" />

==Aftermath==
Despite the Imperial victory, Churhee's Riflemen were celebrated as heroes of the Rebellion.<ref name="GAW" /> The Riflemen already had a formidable reputation in the Parmel and Sarin sectors, but they were now legendary. Their actions during the Battle of Turcan III brought the group [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxywide]] fame and their ranks were quickly replenished.<ref name="AJ15" />

Thereafter, the Rebel Alliance, and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], kept Churhee's Riflemen busy with lucrative, exclusive assignments, in part so that they could exploit the [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] value of having the Riflemen among their ranks.<ref name="GAW" />
